archetypes.name: dyn-gatec-audit
archetypes.rationale: Gate C skip-approve and strong-dissent routing is prompt-contract sensitive.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Gate C accepted-findings audit contract, especially rerun, persistence, strong-dissent, and skip-approve routing. Check that renderer flag propagation is documented for every re-prompt path and that clean, mild, and strong audit outcomes stay distinct. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
